title: The Tutor LMS – eLearning and online course solution plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting…
description: The Tutor LMS WordPress plugin up to version 4.2.0 is vulnerable to stored cross-site scripting (XSS) via the '_tutor_profile_bio' parameter. Authenticated users with subscriber-level access or higher can inject malicious scripts that execute when other users view the affected profile page. The exploit involves an invisible overlay that triggers script execution on clicks, leveraging jQuery to parse injected HTML.
